sentences.text: Anusree Roy & Ors vs Amalendu Samadder on 2 January, 2026

Author: Aniruddha Roy
Bench: Aniruddha Roy
Court No. 38 In The High Court at Calcutta
02.01.2026
Special Civil Jurisdiction (Item No. 25) Appellate Side (Ab) C.P.A.N. 1082 of 2025 in W.P.A. 25125
of 2023 Anusree Roy & Ors.
Vs Amalendu Samadder, Special Land Acquisition Officer (G), Howrah Mr. Tapan Kumar Rakshit
Mr. Surajit Roy ....

For the petitioners Mr. Pinaki Dhole Mr. Sankar Halder .... For the alleged contemnor On the prayer of Mr. Tapan Kumar Rakshit, learned advocate with Mr. Surajit Roy,
learned advocate appearing for the petitioners, time to file exception in the form of affidavit to the report filed by the alleged contemnor stands extended till today.
The exception filed in Court today is taken on record.
Copy has been served.

Pursuant to the direction of this Court dated March 20, 2025 a reasoned order has been passed by the alleged contemnor, inter alia, dated April 21, 2025, annexure P-3 at page 29 of the contempt application.

The relevant observation from the said reasoned order is quoted below:
"Hence, it may be concluded that the initial estimate of re-determined compensation for Plot No. - 1345 prepared by the District Officials was erroneous in the eye of law and hence was corrected and modified at column 20 & 21 of the said estimate by the highest departmental authority on the ground that no such power is conferred on the Collector to award interest over the additional amount of compensation to a claimant u/s 28A of the Act.

The judgment dated 30/03/2010 passed by the of 2006 allowed interest over excess amount of compensation in favour of one Madan Mohan Ghosh,
the reference claimant u/s 18 of the L.A. Act, 1894.
By virtue of such order in respect of one, the other claimants u/s 28A (1) are not entitled for interest while considering their claim by the L.A. Collector, Howrah."
On the basis of the above observation, the petitioners allege that no interest has been calculated and granted to the petitioners pursuant to the order of this Court dated March 20, 2025.
Mr. Pinaki Dhole, learned advocate appears for the alleged contemnor.
The order of the Land Acquisition Tribunal dated March 30, 2010 is still in force and has never been challenged by the State.
So long the said order is in force and has already been acted upon by the State, the State cannot contend anything to the contrary.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the basis of the said order of the Land Acquisition Tribunal dated March 30, 2010 this Court's direction dated March 20, 2025.
The alleged contemnor cannot, at this belated stage, contend that the order of the Tribunal was bad in law and hence no interest should be payable.

Prima facie, it appears to this Court that, the direction of this Court dated March 20, 2025 has been violated in so far as calculation and payment of interest is concerned in terms of the said order of the Land Acquisition Tribunal dated March 30, 2010.

The law is well settled that so long the said order of Land Tribunal remains in force and the same has already been acted upon, the alleged contemnor now cannot take a different plea in a pick and chose method.
The authority cannot sit on appeal over the tribunal's order.

Since the reasoned order has been passed by the alleged contemnor, the alleged contemnor shall explain its conduct by way of an affidavit as to why the direction of this Court dated March 20, 2025 has not yet been complied with, to the extend mentioned above.

If the causes to be shown through the affidavit will not be satisfactory, then this Court may proceed to issue rule and takes further steps following the law of contempt against the alleged contemnor.
Affidavit shall be filed on or before January 30, 2026.
A copy of the affidavit shall be served upon the learned advocate on record for the petitioner.

Pendency of this contempt proceeding shall not preclude the alleged contemnor to comply with the direction of this Court dated March 20, 2025 for calculating and payment of interest to the petitioners as directed therein and to file a compliance report on the next day.
The matter shall appear under the heading "Contempt Application" on February 27, 2026.

(Aniruddha Roy, J.)
